purpose: Typed, instance-local user preferences only; not a game input permit, game patch compatibility profile, Sim personality or installer manifest.
invariants: Read-only defaults never create or mutate state
Toggles are preferences consumed only by explicitly integrated adapters; defaults never grant control authority
Mandatory hard safety (save/presence/scene/15s idle/consent) cannot be turned off
No network, global hooks, telemetry, game saves, silent services, or workstation settings
Settings survive installer uninstall; uninstall never deletes user preferences
One writer via exclusive lock, bounded validated JSON, atomic replacement; bad files fail closed
